question: The distance between the pole and the centre of curvature of a given concave mirror of focal length 0.5 m is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.0m**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The distance between the pole and the centre of curvature of a concave mirror is twice the focal length.
 
• This is because the centre of curvature is located at a distance equal to twice the focal length from the pole.
 
• Given:
 
• Focal length f=0.5 mf = 0.5 \, \text{m} f=0.5m
